summary: Provision ephemeral burst seat pool for vendor trial and KMS access approval
description: Issue summary: A vendor (DataHearth) is running a 3-week proof-of-concept with the DS platform and needs an ephemeral pool of 25 engineer seats labelled 'vendor-trial-engineer' plus scoped KMS (Bring Your Own Key) access for logs and metric export. Impact: Without seats and KMS access the POC kickoff next Monday will be delayed, affecting contract sign-off and sales momentum. Request: Create a temporary license pool of 25 seats that auto-expires after 21 days, configure SCIM group mapping and Okta assignment, create billing tag mapping to project 3-DS-POC, and open an internal KMS approval ticket (HSM-backed if possible). Justification: Sales-approved POC with signed NDA and security questionnaire completed; vendor requires endpoint-level encryption for exported telemetry. Environment: Production identity for SCIM/Okta; seats should live in the main Redwood SSO org and be isolated via group membership. Deadline: 2026-03-18 (POC kickoff prep). Steps to fulfil (high level): 1) Confirm contract and NDA reference numbers with Sales (#SL-3319). 2) Create seat pool in SaaS licensing console named 'vendor-trial-engineer-2026-03' with expiration policy and seat cap 25. 3) Add provisioning SCIM mapping to create group 'vendor-trial-engineer' and configure Okta group push. 4) Configure billing tag/chargeback to cost center 3-DS-POC in licensing system. 5) Raise KMS access request to Security (this ticket + KMS request payload) and scope keys to read-only export. 6) Prepare PR for terraform licensing (infra repo) to make the pool auditable and revertible. 7) Notify vendor and Sales when complete.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Ava Martinez: Opening ticket after Sales confirmed POC and NDA. Requesting seat pool + KMS scope. Linked sales ref SL-3319 in body.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Marcus Li: Taking ownership. Will validate licensing SKU availability and whether we can support auto-expiry via current licensing console. Will coordinate with Security for KMS gating.

2026-03-11 15:37 - Priya Nair (Security): Quick note - we need vendor security attestation and SC access level defined before approving KMS access. Please attach completed vendor questionnaire (already collected by CS).

2026-03-12 08:50 - Marcus Li: Attached questionnaire to linked Confluence page and created PR draft for terraform change: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821. Awaiting Security review for KMS HSM requirement.
investigation_notes: Checked licensing inventory: there are 120 ephemeral seats available for reassignment under the 'ephemeral-burst' SKU; 25 can be reserved without impacting existing teams.

Licensing console does not currently support TTL-based auto-deprovisioning for third-party vendors; workaround: create scheduled job (licensing-cleanup) to remove group membership and revoke SCIM tokens at expiry. Ticket created in infra ops backlog if approved.

Confirmed Okta group push is already enabled for similar pools; will reuse mapping pattern 'group:vendor-.*' in SCIM mapping. Need to ensure SCIM provisioning uses attribute 'costCenter' mapping for billing tagging.

KMS notes: Security prefers HSM-key for vendor telemetry exports. Requesting temporary key alias 'vendor-trial/ds-exports/2026-03' with strict IAM policy limiting Decrypt and GetPublicKey to service account used by vendor exports.
Billing: Finance has asked to attach forecast tag '3-DS-POC' and set an alert threshold of $1500 for run rate. Will include billing owner in PR.

Related infra PR created to add terraform resource redwood_license_pool.vendor_trial_engineer with metadata and lifecycle ignore for expiration automation placeholder. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821
resolution_notes: Pending: Security approval for KMS HSM key and sign-off from Finance on billing tag and alert thresholds.

Workaround prepared: if HSM access denied, configure envelope encryption with vendor-provided key and restrict exports to S3 bucket with KMS encryption using a Redwood-managed key and lifecycle policy. This will be documented in the PR.

Next steps: 1) Security to confirm KMS policy (assigned to Priya). 2) Marcus to merge infra PR after Security review. 3) Run licensing-cleanup job on 2026-04-02 to revoke seats automatically (or earlier if POC ends). 4) Notify Sales and vendor once pool is live.
